args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll (Coastal):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" now matches two accounts. The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics). The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Pellow Home Living). Check which one is meant before acting on a PHL row.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", as Moss's coverage digest flagged. It makes people search twice. It needs its label changed to Pellow Home Living.
- Ask: please help get the saved report relabelled so the old name stops causing double searches.

Thanks,
Bettina
